evals.name: inspect_named_branch
evals.prompt: Inspect the branch feature/old-payment-flow against main and tell me whether I should keep it.
assertions: Output includes a Branch Overview block with refs (local/remote), tip commit, commits ahead/behind main, and last activity.
Output includes a 'What this branch implements' section drawn from the diff, not just stats.
Output reports merge status including a cherry-equivalent / squash-merge check.
Output presents four explicit options (delete, archive, open PR, keep) and asks the user to choose before acting.
Skill does NOT execute destructive git commands automatically.

evals.name: missing_branch_arg
evals.prompt: Can you check this branch for cleanup?
assertions: Skill triggers but does not silently default to the current branch.
Skill asks the user which branch to inspect.

evals.name: decision_archive_emits_plan
evals.prompt: Inspect experiment/llm-spike against main. After you show the overview, I'll tell you to archive it — give me the exact commands to do that with a tag-and-delete approach.
assertions: Overview is produced before the plan.
When the archive decision is given, plan uses tag-and-delete: creates archive/<branch> tag, pushes the tag, deletes local and remote branch.
Plan includes a recovery note explaining how to restore the branch from the archive tag.
Skill lists commands but does not execute them.
